about: What people in the west woods say when no quest needs them. The first entry whose "when" is true is used; an entry with no "when" always matches, so put it last.

say: {@forest-imp} IS SAFE AT HOME. THANK YOU AGAIN, {name}!
HAVE YOU CROSSED THE LITTLE BRIDGE PAST MUSHROOM ISLE YET? THERE'S A SECRET COVE!
PLEASE HURRY, {name}. THE WOODS ARE BIG FOR SOMEONE SO LITTLE!
THE WOODS ARE SO QUIET HERE. JUST FIVE MORE MINUTES OF NAP...
